description: Macter International Limited manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products and is one of Pakistan's largest contract manufacturers, making oral solids and liquids, parenterals in ampoules and vials, topicals, metered-dose inhalers and ear and eye drops, with dedicated facilities for cephalosporins, penicillins and biologics. It was incorporated in 1992, converted to a public limited company in 2011, and its clients include multinational pharmaceutical companies.
